# PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES

## 50

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (1) The Schedules to these Rules set out, with modifications, certain provisions previously contained in the Rules of the Supreme Court 1965 1 and the County Court Rules 1981 2 .

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (2) These Rules apply in relation to the proceedings to which the Schedules apply subject to the provisions in the Schedules and the relevant practice directions.

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (3) A provision previously contained in the Rules of the Supreme Court 1965 –

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (a) is headed ‘RSC’;

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (b) is numbered with the Order and rule numbers it bore as part of the RSC; and

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (c) unless otherwise stated in the Schedules or the relevant practice direction, applies only to proceedings in the High Court.

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (4) A provision previously contained in the County Court Rules 1981 –

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (a) is headed ‘CCR’;

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (b) is numbered with the Order and rule numbers it bore as part of the CCR; and

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (c) unless otherwise stated in the Schedules or the relevant practice direction, applies only to proceedings in the county court.

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (5) A reference in a Schedule to a rule by number alone is a reference to the rule so numbered in the Order in which the reference occurs.

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (6) A reference in a Schedule to a rule by number prefixed by ‘CPR’ is a reference to the rule with that number in these Rules.

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (7) In the Schedules, unless otherwise stated, ‘the Act’ means –

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (a) in a provision headed ‘RSC’, the Supreme Court Act 1981; and

[PART 50 – APPLICATION OF THE SCHEDULES > 50] (b) in a provision headed ‘CCR’, the County Courts Act 1984.

## Footnotes

## 1. S.I. 1965/1776.

## 2. S.I. 1981/1687.
